title: Analytic torsion and R-torsion for unimodular representations
container-title: Journal of the American Mathematical Society
note: J. Amer. Math. Soc. 6(3) (1993), 721-753. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1090/S0894-0347-1993-1189689-4) and AMS open-access text (2026-11-28). Extends the Cheeger-Müller theorem from orthogonal/unitary representations to unimodular (SL_n(C), including non-unitary Ad SL_2(C) hyperbolic holonomy) acyclic representations on closed odd-dimensional manifolds (Theorem 1).
